verdict.rationale: Plaid's own docs say it sends webhooks that programmatically report changes to Items (connection state) and asynchronous processes, and that Transactions keeps you up to date via webhooks, so polling is avoidable for the core cases. However, the pack has no evidence that webhooks are signed or verifiable, and none for balance-update webhooks. Missing for 10: webhook signature/verification documentation, balance-update webhook evidence, explicit connection-state event types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, data changes arrive as signed webhooks — new transactions, balance updates, connection state changes — so my system stays current without polling

citations.quote: Plaid sends webhooks to programmatically inform you about changes to Plaid Items or the status of asynchronous processes.
Retrieve up to 24 months of transaction data and stay up-to-date with webhooks
